import cv2,numpy as np
c=cv2.VideoCapture('example_video.mp4')
fs=[]
while True:
  r,f=c.read()
  if not r:break
  fs.append(f)
bg=cv2.cvtColor(fs[0],cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
for i,f in enumerate(fs):
  g=cv2.cvtColor(f,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
  d=cv2.absdiff(g,bg); m=(d>30).astype(np.uint8)
  m=cv2.morphologyEx(m,cv2.MORPH_OPEN,np.ones((3,3),np.uint8))
  ys,xs=np.nonzero(m)
  if len(ys)>200: print(i,len(ys),xs.min(),xs.max(),ys.min(),ys.max())
  else: print(i,len(ys))
# grid
sm=[cv2.resize(fs[i],(320,180)) for i in range(0,120,6)]
rows=[np.hstack(sm[k:k+4]) for k in range(0,20,4)]
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/fr/grid.jpg',np.vstack(rows))
"
